approvals.reason: Pre-lock removal adopted from Silo #2586: Silo no longer supports Trakt, and the operation already refused every request with 410 unsupported_source. Bloem's bundled web client never called it; bloem-apple and bloem-android only carry its generated DTO and never call it. The frozen v1 route keeps its 410.
